name: Munchy Munch Waitress
source:
The waitress is the sole proprietor of the "Munchy Munch Restaurant And Tea Rooms", and as such is an ideal target for Grendel's light fingers.

Such is the frequency that the waitress has had her tills stolen, she is quite afraid of Grendel, and will do anything to get rid of her quickly.  Naturally, this delights Grendel as it means free food.
